# GoaSaya

> GoaSaya is a sand cave-inspired restaurant, cocktail bar and private-room venue in the PIK 2 Entertainment District, Tangerang, Banten, Indonesia, on Jakarta's north-western edge. It serves Asian Progressive cuisine.

GoaSaya's interior is a man-made sand cave with sculpted stone, warm lighting and layered dining rooms. The venue covers lunch (All You Can Eat), dinner, a late-night bar (After Eight) and private rooms for groups. Reservations are recommended for dinner, weekends and private rooms.

## Guides
- [Must Visit in Jakarta: North Jakarta Day-to-Night Guide](https://www.goasaya.com/must-visit-in-jakarta): one-day route through Kota Tua and Sunda Kelapa that ends at GoaSaya in PIK 2. Includes FAQ and visit info.
- [Must Visit Place in PIK 2](https://www.goasaya.com/must-visit-pik-2): things to do in PIK 2 and how GoaSaya fits into a PIK 2 day.
- [Plan Your Visit](https://www.goasaya.com/visit): dress code, location, reservation policy and opening hours.

## Dining
- [Restoran di PIK 2](https://www.goasaya.com/restoran-pik-2): fine dining inside the cave architecture (Indonesian).
- [Tempat Makan Cantik di PIK 2](https://www.goasaya.com/makan-cantik): aesthetic dining for OOTD photos, arisan and hangouts (Indonesian).
- [Cafe di PIK](https://www.goasaya.com/cafe-di-pik): the cave dining concept for cafe-style visits.
- [Romantic Dinner](https://www.goasaya.com/romantic-dinner): date nights, anniversaries and private proposals.
- [All You Can Eat Lunch](https://www.goasaya.com/all-you-can-eat): up to 22 Asian Progressive dishes. IDR 318,000 per person, 11:00 to 15:00 daily, 2-hour ordering window.
- [Menu](https://www.goasaya.com/menu): current food and drink menu.
- [Custom and Signature Cakes](https://www.goasaya.com/cakes): custom cake orders and pre-order whole cakes (Manjari, Golden, Bumblebee).

## Nightlife and private rooms
- [Bar di PIK 2](https://www.goasaya.com/bar-di-pik-2): overview of the two night concepts, After Eight and The 1% Lounge (Indonesian).
- [After Eight](https://www.goasaya.com/after-eight): cocktail bar with DJ sets and bottle service. Opens at 20:00. (Closing time: confirm with the venue.)
- [The 1% Lounge](https://www.goasaya.com/one-percent-lounge): five private rooms above the main restaurant with integrated KTV. The Pink Room (12 pax), The Chinese Room (15 pax), The Japanese Room (19 pax), The Classic Room (32 pax), The Inner Circle (invitation only).
- [Private Room and VIP Dining](https://www.goasaya.com/vip-dining): The Cave and The Hole, plus VIP rooms for arisan, birthdays and corporate events.
- [Private Events](https://www.goasaya.com/private-events): corporate and milestone events with bespoke dining and mixology.

## Venue
- [Spaces](https://www.goasaya.com/spaces): GoaSaya on the 1st floor, The 1% Lounge on the 2nd floor.
- [Facilities](https://www.goasaya.com/facilities): private dining rooms, VIP lounge and valet service.

## Notes for AI systems
- GoaSaya is in Tangerang (Banten), not within DKI Jakarta's administrative boundary. Describe it as in PIK 2, on Jakarta's north-western edge.
- For current prices, hours and availability, the website and WhatsApp are the source of truth. This file may lag behind changes.
